purpose: Exact local nontrivial-annulus survival claim in Menasco1984 Lemma1 case2.
interface: Countable choice; decomposing sphere with both side one-string tangles nontrivial; a supplied meridional disk in one side separates the two punctures on its boundary and crosses the link once.
proof_plan: Cut side ball along supplied disk into two balls using Schoenflies. Original side nontrivial implies at least one child side nontrivial by ball-tangle criterion; its complementary side is a boundary sum containing the original opposite nontrivial factor.
not_claimed: Does not supply crossing-ball disk normalization, saddle decrease, preservation of individual prime factors, or the composite flyping theorem.
